orig.credit: Donga and Mauro de Almeida (1916), the original opening as quoted in Wikipedia's article

notes: line 1.1: 'folia' is carnival merrymaking, revelry; 'o chefe da folia' is the leader of the revels.

lines 1.5-1.6: 'Não se questione / Para se brincar' is loosely put; read as 'let no one question (or quarrel over) joining in the fun'. 'questionar' can be 'to question' or 'to dispute, argue'; 'brincar' is 'to play', in carnival 'to revel'.
